summary: The unchanged Daily classic-pivot × H1 wick interaction confirmed on the protected 2022-2025 Dukascopy FX Cash holdout: +1.084 pp with 95% CI [+0.654,+1.543] pp, positive in all ten pairs, all four calendar years, both preregistered two-year halves and every leave-one-pair-out pool. The five-bin core wick gradient remained monotonic. This confirms the structural/observable association but does not establish an executable reversal strategy.
robustness: independent compact-ledger arithmetic recalculation matched the recorded primary and structural effects exactly
limitations: Structural midpoint analysis; no executable BID/ASK P&L.
Terminal identity is retrospective although wick geometry is observable at H1 close.
This holdout confirms an association, not entry timing, stop placement, target logic or cost-adjusted expectancy.
The 2022-2025 Daily/H1 holdout is consumed for this exact question.
authorized_next: Design a new causal/execution study using the frozen confirmed Daily/H1 structural signal without retuning it.
Test observable confirmation timing, invalidation geometry and executable BID/ASK costs under a new preregistration.
prohibited_next: Do not retune the Daily pivot-zone width, wick thresholds, pair universe, named pivots or sessions on the consumed 2022-2025 holdout.
Do not treat holdout confirmation as live-trading, Pine, alert or sizing authorization.
